name: spend-buddy
description: Spend Buddy authentication starter: Next.js, NestJS and Keycloak

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api "npm run start --workspace=@spend-buddy/web" "npm run start --workspace=@spend-buddy/api"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
